title: 网络安全 · 售前方案设计 30 句
description: 覆盖需求澄清、架构设计、集成、容量规划、概念验证与验收标准的网络安全售前英语。

items.zh: 为了判断方案是否适用，我们需要了解客户要改善的流程，而不只是所需功能清单。
items.en: To determine whether the solution is suitable, we need to understand the process the client wants to improve, not merely the requested feature list.
answers: To determine whether the solution is suitable, we need to understand the process the client wants to improve, not merely the requested feature list.
items.notes: whether 引导判断内容；not merely 区分业务流程与功能清单。

items.zh: 请说明每个用例由谁处理、多久发生一次，以及什么结果才算成功。
items.en: Please clarify who handles each use case, how often it occurs, and what outcome would constitute success.
answers: Please clarify who handles each use case, how often it occurs, and what outcome would constitute success.
items.notes: 三个疑问词从句并列；constitute success 表示构成成功。

items.zh: 现有流程的瓶颈出现在数据收集、分析判断还是响应授权环节？
items.en: Does the current process break down at data collection, analytical decision-making, or response authorisation?
answers: Does the current process break down at data collection, analytical decision-making, or response authorisation?
items.notes: break down at 用于定位流程失效环节；三项选择便于澄清。

items.zh: 有些要求看似属于产品能力，实际上取决于客户能否提供完整可靠的数据。
items.en: Some requirements appear to concern product capability but actually depend on the client's ability to provide complete and reliable data.
answers: Some requirements appear to concern product capability but actually depend on the client's ability to provide complete and reliable data.
items.notes: appear to ... but actually... 对比表象与真实依赖；ability to do 是固定结构。

items.zh: 在确认技术方案之前，我们应区分强制要求、偏好以及未来可能需要的能力。
items.en: Before confirming the technical design, we should distinguish mandatory requirements from preferences and possible future capabilities.
answers: Before confirming the technical design, we should distinguish mandatory requirements from preferences and possible future capabilities.
items.notes: distinguish A from B；before doing 表明设计顺序。

items.zh: 建议的架构把管理流量与采集流量分开，从而减少管理接口的暴露。
items.en: The proposed architecture separates management traffic from collection traffic, thereby reducing exposure of the administrative interface.
answers: The proposed architecture separates management traffic from collection traffic, thereby reducing exposure of the administrative interface.
items.notes: separate A from B；thereby doing 说明直接结果。

items.zh: 由于部分站点带宽有限，边缘节点会先过滤低价值事件，再把数据传送到中央平台。
items.en: Because bandwidth is constrained at several sites, edge nodes will filter low-value events before forwarding data to the central platform.
answers: Because bandwidth is constrained at several sites, edge nodes will filter low-value events before forwarding data to the central platform.
items.notes: because 解释设计原因；before doing 表示处理顺序。

items.zh: 高可用设计消除了单个应用节点故障，却仍依赖共享数据库的恢复能力。
items.en: The high-availability design removes the risk of a single application-node failure, although it still depends on the recoverability of the shared database.
answers: The high-availability design removes the risk of a single application-node failure, although it still depends on the recoverability of the shared database.
items.notes: although 揭示高可用边界；depend on 指剩余依赖。

items.zh: 如果管理平面必须与互联网隔离，更新服务就需要经过客户现有的代理。
items.en: If the management plane must remain isolated from the internet, the update service will need to use the client's existing proxy.
answers: If the management plane must remain isolated from the internet, the update service will need to use the client's existing proxy.
items.notes: if 引出网络约束；remain isolated 表示保持隔离。

items.zh: 该设计选择区域内存储，是为了满足数据驻留要求，而不是出于性能考虑。
items.en: The design uses in-region storage to satisfy data-residency requirements rather than for performance reasons.
answers: The design uses in-region storage to satisfy data-residency requirements rather than for performance reasons.
items.notes: to satisfy 表目的；rather than for 对比设计依据。

items.zh: 目录集成将采用只读服务账户，其权限仅限于查询所需的属性。
items.en: The directory integration will use a read-only service account whose permissions are limited to the attributes required for queries.
answers: The directory integration will use a read-only service account whose permissions are limited to the attributes required for queries.
items.notes: whose 引导所属关系定语从句；be limited to 表示权限边界。

items.zh: 接口支持双向同步，但冲突记录必须由一个系统作为最终权威来源。
items.en: The interface supports bidirectional synchronisation, but one system must remain the authoritative source when records conflict.
answers: The interface supports bidirectional synchronisation, but one system must remain the authoritative source when records conflict.
items.notes: authoritative source 指权威数据源；when 说明冲突情形。

items.zh: 若设备不支持标准日志格式，解析器开发应作为单独的交付项估算。
items.en: Where a device does not support a standard log format, parser development should be estimated as a separate deliverable.
answers: Where a device does not support a standard log format, parser development should be estimated as a separate deliverable.
items.notes: where 引出适用场景；be estimated as 表示单独估算。

items.zh: 客户需在部署前开通出站连接，否则云端注册无法完成。
items.en: The client must permit the outbound connection before deployment; otherwise, cloud registration cannot be completed.
answers: The client must permit the outbound connection before deployment; otherwise, cloud registration cannot be completed.
items.notes: otherwise 清楚说明前置条件未满足的后果。

items.zh: 我们已确认工单系统能够接收事件，但仍需验证状态回写是否保留审计轨迹。
items.en: We have confirmed that the ticketing system can receive incidents, but we still need to verify whether status updates preserve the audit trail.
answers: We have confirmed that the ticketing system can receive incidents, but we still need to verify whether status updates preserve the audit trail.
items.notes: confirm that 与 verify whether 区分已知事实和待验证事项。

items.zh: 容量模型使用的是高峰事件速率，因为每日平均值会低估突发负载。
items.en: The capacity model uses the peak event rate because a daily average would understate burst demand.
answers: The capacity model uses the peak event rate because a daily average would understate burst demand.
items.notes: would understate 表示采用平均值可能低估；because 解释建模选择。

items.zh: 保留期从九十天增加到一年，不仅影响存储，还会延长备份和恢复窗口。
items.en: Extending retention from ninety days to one year affects not only storage but also backup and recovery windows.
answers: Extending retention from ninety days to one year affects not only storage but also backup and recovery windows.
items.notes: not only ... but also 连接两类容量影响；动名词短语作主语。

items.zh: 当前估算预留了百分之二十的增长空间，但没有包含计划中的收购项目。
items.en: The current estimate allows twenty per cent headroom for growth but excludes the planned acquisition.
answers: The current estimate allows twenty per cent headroom for growth but excludes the planned acquisition.
items.notes: allow headroom for 表示预留余量；but excludes 明确估算边界。

items.zh: 如果日志量超过许可上限，系统会继续采集还是优先丢弃低价值数据？
items.en: If log volume exceeds the licensed limit, will the system continue collecting everything or discard lower-value data first?
answers: If log volume exceeds the licensed limit, will the system continue collecting everything or discard lower-value data first?
items.notes: if 引出超限场景；or 澄清产品具体行为。

items.zh: 性能测试应模拟最繁忙时段，而不是在空闲环境中证明理论吞吐量。
items.en: Performance testing should simulate the busiest operational period rather than demonstrate theoretical throughput in an idle environment.
answers: Performance testing should simulate the busiest operational period rather than demonstrate theoretical throughput in an idle environment.
items.notes: rather than 对比真实压力和理论指标；simulate 表示模拟。

items.zh: 概念验证只检验三个最重要的用例，以便在有限时间内获得明确结论。
items.en: The proof of concept will test only the three most important use cases so that a clear conclusion can be reached within the available time.
answers: The proof of concept will test only the three most important use cases so that a clear conclusion can be reached within the available time.
items.notes: so that 引出限定范围的目的；被动语态强调结论。

items.zh: 双方必须使用同一份测试数据，否则结果差异可能源于输入而非产品。
items.en: Both parties must use the same test data; otherwise, differences in the results may arise from the inputs rather than the product.
answers: Both parties must use the same test data; otherwise, differences in the results may arise from the inputs rather than the product.
items.notes: arise from 表示源于；rather than 区分原因。

items.zh: 若某项标准需要主观判断，应事先指定由谁作出最终决定。
items.en: Where a criterion requires subjective judgement, the person making the final decision should be nominated in advance.
answers: Where a criterion requires subjective judgement, the person making the final decision should be nominated in advance.
items.notes: where 引出特定条件；making 作后置定语。

items.zh: 一次失败的测试未必意味着产品不适用，它也可能暴露了未满足的依赖。
items.en: A failed test does not necessarily mean that the product is unsuitable; it may instead reveal an unmet dependency.
answers: A failed test does not necessarily mean that the product is unsuitable; it may instead reveal an unmet dependency.
items.notes: not necessarily 限制推论；may instead 提出替代解释。

items.zh: 试点结束时，我们会把已验证能力、未解决问题和生产化前提分别记录。
items.en: At the end of the pilot, we will document validated capabilities, unresolved issues, and prerequisites for production separately.
answers: At the end of the pilot, we will document validated capabilities, unresolved issues, and prerequisites for production separately.
items.notes: 三个并列对象覆盖正面、问题和后续条件；separately 避免混淆。

items.zh: 验收标准要求高风险告警在五分钟内到达平台，而不是要求调查在五分钟内完成。
items.en: The acceptance criterion requires high-risk alerts to reach the platform within five minutes; it does not require the investigation to be completed within that period.
answers: The acceptance criterion requires high-risk alerts to reach the platform within five minutes; it does not require the investigation to be completed within that period.
items.notes: require A to do 与 require A to be done；分号澄清指标含义。

items.zh: 方案文档应明确哪些组件由供应商管理，哪些仍由客户维护。
items.en: The solution document should make clear which components are managed by the supplier and which remain under client administration.
answers: The solution document should make clear which components are managed by the supplier and which remain under client administration.
items.notes: make clear 后接并列 which 从句；remain under 表示持续由谁管理。

items.zh: 迁移计划先并行运行新旧检测流程，以便在停用旧系统前比较覆盖率。
items.en: The migration plan runs the new and old detection processes in parallel so that coverage can be compared before the legacy system is retired.
answers: The migration plan runs the new and old detection processes in parallel so that coverage can be compared before the legacy system is retired.
items.notes: in parallel 表示并行；before 引导停用前的验证顺序。

items.zh: 任何超出标准部署的定制都应说明成本、负责人以及对升级的长期影响。
items.en: Any customisation beyond the standard deployment should state its cost, owner, and long-term effect on upgrades.
answers: Any customisation beyond the standard deployment should state its cost, owner, and long-term effect on upgrades.
items.notes: beyond 表示超出范围；三个并列项目使定制影响透明。

items.zh: 只有在关键假设获得客户确认后，最终设计和实施报价才会冻结。
items.en: The final design and implementation estimate will be baselined only after the client has confirmed the critical assumptions.
answers: The final design and implementation estimate will be baselined only after the client has confirmed the critical assumptions.
items.notes: only after 强调冻结条件；baseline 作动词表示建立正式基线。
